subject: Myth & Symbolism
title: Dream Temples of Greece
description: A fast breakdown of Dream Temples of Greece for builders.

hook.text: Ancient Greeks slept in temples hoping for healing dreams. They called it incubation.

buildup.text: At Epidaurus, pilgrims fasted, bathed, then slept near the altar of Asclepius, god of medicine.

discovery.text: Priests interpreted dreams as divine messages. The god spoke through symbols while you slept.

twist.text: Modern sleep labs confirm dreams consolidate memory and process emotions. The Greeks weren't wrong.

climax.text: Different language, same insight: dreams carry information the waking mind can't access directly.

punchline.text: We stopped building temples. Not dreaming.

quiz.question: What was dream incubation in ancient Greece?
options: Sleeping in temples for healing dreams
A method of fortune-telling with cards
